mathematics.assertion_tested: Build the rainbow-union polynomial from matching-event conflict graphs on all six hosts; compare every coefficient with the saved avoiding histograms, and compare all 144 probabilities, moments, and order-two/order-three Bonferroni bounds.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integer polynomials and rational probabilities; floating-point seconds only in benchmark measurements
mathematics.conventions: Independent uniform colors from q available labels; arbitrary edge colorings; fixed edge order; conflict graphs include unused positions as isolated vertices; polynomial coefficients in ascending powers of q.
inputs: C4, C6, C8, two disjoint C4, K3,3, and the cube
non_claims: No new theorem or originality claim
The counting engine does not read partition histograms; they are used only by the comparison experiment
